name: fixed
algorithm: Per round, splitmix64 gives r; a list of (r & 511) + 1 u64 values r + i is built in a fixed-buffer allocator over a 64 KiB stack buffer with the standard growable list, summed, released, and the allocator reset; the checksum is the wrapping sum over rounds (../README.md).

skip.c: no fixed-buffer allocator in the C standard library
skip.rust: no fixed-buffer allocator in Rust's standard library (the Allocator API is unstable)
skip.go: no fixed-buffer allocator in Go's standard library

notes: Mk: std.mem.Fixed and HeapList[u64]; Zig: std.heap.FixedBufferAllocator and std.ArrayList(u64). The lists grow differently (Mk max(4, 2 cap), Zig cap + cap/2 + 8), both in place in the buffer.
